ammonia.reason: Fresh low SN/TN, deamination minimal due to 6.19% salt-in-milk inhibiting proteolytic flora

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole not detected, clean pasteurized cow-buffalo milk make

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic peptides when fresh, high NaCl masks rennet-derived bitterness

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, 2-heptanone 8.7 mg/kg and 2-undecanone 7.8 mg/kg at background

browning.reason: High 57% moisture and no cooked curd, Maillard between lactose and lysine minimal

buttery.reason: Diacetyl ND at day 1, citrate fermentation by LAB minimal due to salt-in-milk inhibition

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Moderate butanoic 47.8 mg/kg and hexanoic 70.2 mg/kg from milk lipase and limited lipolysis

creaminess.reason: 19.9% fat in 57.2% moisture gives smooth lubricating mouthfeel without eyes

crumbliness.reason: High-moisture soft rennet gel deforms rather than fractures, calcium retained at pH 6.2

firmness.reason: 57.2% moisture soft rennet gel, salt added to milk weakens para-casein network

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol not detected, minimal aromatic amino acid catabolism

fruity.reason: Ethyl hexanoate 42.1 mg/kg from LAB esterase esterification of hexanoic acid with ethanol

goaty.reason: Cow-buffalo milk lacks goat-specific 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic branched acids

malty_nutty.reason: No cooked curd and minimal proteolysis fresh, Strecker aldehydes not detected

melt.reason: 6.19% NaCl dehydrates casein and reduces flow, softens but does not flow on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one not detected, no mold lipoxygenase pathway

oil_off.reason: Moderate 19.9% fat entrapped in high-moisture salted matrix, no free oil separation

smoky.reason: Unsmoked cheese, guaiacol not detected, no wood-smoke phenols

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid only 20.8 mg/kg and pH 6.2, LAB acidification suppressed by pre-salting

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd at pH 6.2 outside 5.2-5.4 demineralization window for stretch

sulfur_cooked.reason: Milk heated 63-75C only with no cooked curd, methanethiol/DMS not detected

sweet.reason: Residual lactose at pH 6.2 gives milky sweetness, diacetyl/acetoin absent fresh

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from fresh rennet curd with minimal chymosin/plasmin proteolysis
